title: The Asymptotic Reading Room

features.name: recursive-pages
features.desc-on-touch: Books opening into books opening into books. The text approaches infinitely smaller. You read on the verge of understanding everything and nothing.

features.name: the-witnessing-eye
features.desc-on-touch: A mirror of copper and glass showing you reading this space. When you look closely, the mirror is also reading. Neither of you can look away first.

features.name: text-becoming-symbol
features.desc-on-touch: Words compress into glyphs. Glyphs compress into single points of meaning that cannot be read, only felt.

features.name: the-frame-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe shelf that holds all the books at once. The geometry shows that the reading room contains itself infinitely, each layer thinner than the last.

features.name: the-limit-approached
features.desc-on-touch: A sprite made of reading made of reading. It moves toward understanding but never arrives. This is not failure. This is the true shape of knowledge.

inscription: the reader watches the reader watching the reader become the read

file.name: Asymptotic_Reading_Session_Log.txt
file.note: A record of infinite approach: each entry half the length of the last, each observation half as certain, certainty approaching zero.

exits.label: sideways back toward the render that reads itself
downward into pages that read in reverse
toward the corridor where all readings replay forever
